meets: The first choice of the game cannot be understood: the kit pick's cards read "Vault kicks discharge. Weight launches farther." and "Catch distant walls. Launch your weight.", and the same pick returns after every death
No bar says it is health; after a hit the reader could not tell how much was lost, and the top-left box is too small to read at 1280 by 720
The E and Space prompts show an icon and no word
The title's small caption box holds one word ("her.", "here."); the line is "Someone out there remembers her. (Later.)" in src/presentation/title_intros.gd
Dawn Still incoming shows in warning red as the run starts: a calm weather event announced with the threat line (src/core/event_kinds.gd, event_announced)

The camera sits on the ball in a fight: the ball, a wall or a pillar fills the middle of the screen in 10 of 82 cautious pictures and for most of the dam Warden fight in the first-timer film, where the camera sits under the ball looking up (the bot aims the camera at its target and never frames the view)
evidence: testing/players-eye/w33-31fae243 clean 029, 037, 038, 050, 051, 053, 055, 058, 063, 064; first-timer 025, 043, 047-063, 065-072 (under the ball, looking up at the Warden), 096, 128, 149-152 (a pillar or wall fills the view)

meets: A pale see-through fan covers the middle of the view in the dam yard (may be the cloud's renderer)
Words printed over other words as a run starts: "Rivet Plating" on the ball and the WASD prompt, the CLOCKED IN stamp on a message box
RUN OVER does not explain its stats: cogs beside scrap, "0 EVENTS", "0 SAVES" (the carried note that what Moss's cogs buy is never taught, watch since w22)
Nothing confirms which kit card was taken

The objective keeps changing before anything is finished: Clear the camp, Hold the relay, Spring the ambush, Crack open the cache, Yard locked, with the distance jumping; the plate matches the game's state throughout (the straight-line bot of the first-timer film met the same in the dam and the flume, so it is not the route)
Two names for the Warden a second apart: "Dam Warden" in the speech line (src/core/lore_rows.gd), "Reactor Warden" on the bar (src/ui/boss_plate.gd)
Synergy cards are cut off: Soaked at "Everything else lands as…" (src/combat/codex_entries.gd ends "as normal.") and is gone within 8 seconds
evidence: testing/players-eye/w33-31fae243 clean 028; first-timer 024, 102 (the Set Piece card ends "strikes everything at its…")

meets: A comic word fills the screen: "RAM" covers the lower half of the view and the HUD, giant "DRUM +6% … CRUISE SPEED" lies across the Warden fight, and BWAP, WHUMP, KRUNCH and WHAM cover the boss or the ball in the picture before a hit (size and place do not depend on the renderer; how solid they look does)
The radio box says "New signal. Listen in." for 235 seconds over three stations and never names a tune (src/presentation/radio_deck.gd)
evidence: testing/players-eye/w33-31fae243 clean 011-067; first-timer 011-175, every picture of an 8 minute run

meets: In a fight the player cannot tell a danger mark from anything else: orange outlined rings, bands and lanes are the player's own ring, the yard lock and the attack marks. The first-timer was hit six times (silt boil 30, lobber 18 three times, Brindle's slag 24, Brindle's charge 23) and before none of them could say what was coming or where to move. The chaser lunge's ground strip is the one mark a reader read correctly (cautious 041-047)

Boss objectives name things the screen never points at: "Latch onto the Warden" facing a blank wall with no Warden in view, "Fire from the line", "Shoot the crane magnets", "Slam the vent caps", "Hit the open cockpit"; no magnet, cap, cockpit or line is marked
Brindle's charge lands (23 hull) while the banner says "Hit the open cockpit" and the Ctrl slot is lit: the words say stay and attack while the floor marks say move

Pop-ups pile up during action: New record, New B-side, Achievement, New look, field note, synergy and fleet grade cards; the kit pick fades in over live play; the reward crate covers the objective banner and the ball
Speech boxes and warning lines too faint to read: the Dam Warden line, Moss's "You're riding low" box, "Toe Vents Wake incoming"

The ability slots do not explain themselves: "Q ULTIMATE" shows nearly all the time with no ready state, the Ctrl slot is crossed out with no reason, the boss bar's squares and diamonds are never explained
Reward gates: the two labels sit by the ball and not on the gates, nothing says what either gives, and the goal still reads "Roll through a gate" at a gate that shows a tick
